research_question: Does explicitly representing customer/window consumption behaviour improve theft discrimination beyond the raw 30-point consumption window?
input_scope: Features are deterministic functions only of each existing usable stride-30 window's 30 scaled consumption values.

feature_definitions.mean: Arithmetic mean of the 30 scaled values.
feature_definitions.q10: 10th percentile using NumPy's default linear quantile interpolation.
feature_definitions.q90: 90th percentile using NumPy's default linear quantile interpolation.
feature_definitions.mean_absolute_deviation: Mean absolute deviation from the window mean.
feature_definitions.first_to_last_change: Last scaled value minus first scaled value.
feature_definitions.mean_absolute_consecutive_change: Mean absolute first difference across adjacent positions.
feature_definitions.maximum_absolute_consecutive_change: Maximum absolute first difference across adjacent positions.
feature_definitions.linear_slope: Least-squares slope against fixed zero-based positions 0 through 29.
feature_definitions.fraction_below_minus_one: Fraction of values at or below -1.0 in the established training-standardized feature space; low relative consumption, not physical zero usage.
feature_definitions.second_half_minus_first_half_mean: Mean of positions 15–29 minus mean of positions 0–14.

representation_matrix.RAW_PLUS_SUMMARY: 47 columns: raw 30 followed by the 17 summaries

logistic_regression.standardization: StandardScaler fitted on Stage 14 training windows only

threshold_policy: For each fitted model/representation, maximize positive-class F1 on validation separately at window level and after customer mean-probability aggregation.
primary_selection_policy: Highest customer-mean validation ROC-AUC, then customer-mean average precision, then window ROC-AUC; no test information.
feature_importance_policy: For the selected tree model only, permute each pre-registered summary column across validation windows five times with seed 42 and report the mean customer ROC-AUC and average-precision decrease. If RAW_ONLY wins, raw positions are assessed instead.
leakage_exclusions: window number, feature indices, and dates
Stage 13 predictions and all reconstruction-model outputs
test features, test predictions, and test labels
test_policy: CLOSED. Stage 14 code and execution load train and validation only; no Stage 14 candidate is evaluated on test.
feature_revision_policy: No feature may be added, removed, or redefined after validation scoring unless a documented implementation bug is found.
